neuronal_methods.unit: independent differentiation summary; technical measurements averaged; one parental donor background
neuronal_methods.deletions: full; all six single-arm delete-one subsets; all nine Cartesian delete-one-per-arm subsets per endpoint
neuronal_methods.null: inclusive absolute mean difference over all unpaired same-size allocations; arm exchangeability assumption
neuronal_methods.family: two full-data exact tests, Holm; deletion results descriptive only
neuronal_methods.pairing: no inferred row pairing or cross-endpoint linkage
neuronal_methods.confirmation: none; no new biological units and no endpoint or subset selection

exposure_methods.assumptions: all64 existing combinations, no weights or probability interpretation
exposure_methods.scope: adult reported-mean scenarios; post-peak decay only, no absorption/repeated dosing/tissue distribution/pharmacodynamic persistence or case-specific PK

retuning: no new endpoint/sign choice/panel/drug ranking/cutoff optimization or parameter fit
